meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成 LazyCodex 安装医生:将本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 安装和最新源码对比,产出逐项 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上产生它的命令输出或文件;只做诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求体检或健康检查,提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词,或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 表现异常、怀疑安装过时或损坏时触发。

say.text: 给 LazyCodex 和 Codex 做个体检,输出诊断报告
我上次更新后 Codex 表现有点怪,帮我查是哪出了问题
say.note: 会检查配置、插件负载和运行时探针,并附证据

say.text: 检查我的 Astra readiness 和 config.toml 是否正常
say.note: 会对照 0.153.1 版本门槛检查模型缓存

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a LazyCodex install doctor: it compares your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites the command output or file behind it. Diagnosis only; it never changes your install, config, or repos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, say LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change, or the setup looks stale or broken.

say_en.text: Run a health check on LazyCodex and Codex and give me the report.
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources, then checks each item with a verdict

say_en.text: Codex has acted odd since my last update — find out what's wrong.
say_en.note: Checks config, plugin payload, and runtime probes with evidence

say_en.text: Check my Astra readiness and config.toml against the latest source.
say_en.note: Compares against the 0.153.1 floor and model cache
